description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting input strings to camelCase and Title Case formats. These functions are used across the application to normalize and display strings consistently.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling delimiters such as spaces, underscores, and hyphens. It normalizes the string by trimming, collapsing whitespace, and then converting the string to camelCase starting with a lowercase letter.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case suitable for display. It normalizes delimiters and whitespace, lowercases the string, then capitalizes the first letter of each word and the letter following an apostrophe, preserving accented characters and special punctuation.
